title: [DEV] aaps cannot load the settings and restarts after update to latest dev
symptom: After updating to the latest dev build, the app crashes within 7-8 seconds. Clearing cache or data does not help; when restoring settings, it crashes again. Only switching to virtual pump stops crashes, but setting back to DanaRv2 causes crashes again.
cause: The crashes are related to missing Bluetooth permission, and there is a fix for latest MIUI in dev.
fix: The issue is resolved in the dev branch after a fix for latest MIUI was added; user confirmed it is resolved.
evidence_quote: i see crashes related to missing BT permission
